title: Mass-notification alert
description: An emergency / mass-notification alert as the recipient sees it: a Wireless Emergency Alert on a phone lock screen (wea), an opt-in agency text alert (sms), an alert email (email), or the printed script card an operator reads over a siren / PA system (siren_pa). All variants are 480 px wide.

sender.description: Issuing agency. Falls back to brand.aliases.org.

senderShortCode.description: SMS short code or sender address the alert comes from.

headline.description: Alert headline (the WEA lead is shown in capitals).

body.description: Alert message text as sent. WEA messages are short (under 360 characters).
examples: Cedar Ridge Dam operators report a possible failure. Leave Inundation Zone A now. Go to high ground east of Route 9. Do not drive through flood water.

issuedAt.description: Issue time as the device or document shows it.

examples: Inundation Zone A — City of Milford

instructions.description: Protective action instructions, one per item.
examples: Take medications, pets and phone chargers
Shelter: Milford High School, 400 Ridge Rd

moreInfoUrl.description: Plain-text web address for more information (not a link).

severity.description: Severity; drives the colour band and the alert class wording.

isTest.description: When true the alert shows THIS IS A TEST. Default false.

clock.description: Phone status-bar clock (wea and sms variants).
